thread:
lina (docs): Heads up — I'm updating the localization matrix to include Mainland China availability + a short data-handling note. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 — need quick reviews from intl and legal.

sam (intl): Looking now. Quick Q: do we want to mark China as 'available with restrictions' or 'not offered'? The platform can support private/dedicated deployments in China via partners, but Hosted API is not in CN.

matt (platform): Hosted endpoints aren't deployed to Mainland China. Suggest phrasing: 'Hosted API is not offered in Mainland China; private and dedicated deployments may be available via partners — contact sales.' Thoughts?

emily (legal): Minor wording change: prefer 'not offered' over 'not available' and add 'subject to local regulations'. Approved sentence for docs: "Hosted API is not offered in Mainland China. Customers requiring deployment in Mainland China should contact Sales for private or dedicated solutions; deployments are subject to applicable laws and contractual terms."

lina (docs): Thanks. Also need to update the console/SDK snippet — current example shows the header `X-Region: eu`. We should add a CN example and call out that region headers don't apply to Hosted requests in CN. Proposed snippet to include in PR: ```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY',
    'X-Region': 'cn'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello' })
})
``` Any objections?

zoe (eng): Quick FYI — setting `X-Region: cn` on our Hosted API will return 403 right now. We should explicitly mark that this header is for Dedicated/Private deployments only. Better pattern: show endpoint selection for CN (example `https://cn.api.redwood.ai`) instead of header. Also add a short runtime note about 403 so users don't get surprised.

lina (docs): Good catch. I'll change the snippet to show endpoint selection and add a bold note that Hosted requests to the public API with `X-Region: cn` will be rejected. Emily — can you confirm the legal-approved sentence fits with that note?

emily (legal): :thumbsup: That wording is fine. Also prefer the term 'Mainland China' consistently.

sam (intl): I'll add the i18n TODO to ping translations for zh-CN once final copy is in. Also found an old internal link in the region page that points to the internal tracker: https://internal.redwood/region-status — needs to be updated to https://www.redwood.ai/regions. Can someone fix that small link?

matt (platform): I'll open a tiny PR to swap that link to the public page.

lina (docs): Plan: Lina updates PR with new endpoint-snippet + 403 warning, Sam adds i18n note, Matt updates link, Emily drops final approved legal sentence into the PR. Target: ship by EOD tomorrow. Any blockers?

zoe (eng): No infra blockers, but please add a KMS/HSM note for CN deployments (customers should use customer-managed keys for compliance).

lina (docs): Added to checklist. Thanks all :rocket:
